info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Payment Status Retrieval API allows users to access the current status of payments processed through the payment gateway. This endpoint provides insights into payment statuses, facilitating tracking and management of payment transactions. Typical consumers include finance teams and payment administrators who need to monitor payment outcomes in real-time. The API streamlines payment oversight, ensuring that stakeholders have the necessary information to make informed decisions and resolve any potential issues.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of a payment.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the latest status of a specified payment. It returns detailed information regarding whether the payment is pending, completed, or failed. Use this to monitor transaction outcomes in real-time.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the payment status. It includes the necessary parameters to check the status of a specific payment transaction.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content to return.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the status of payments in the GET request body.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusResponse_204.title: Payment Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the payment status check was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the payment.

resultId.description: Identifier for the specific result of the payment status operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the payment status check, in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message related to the payment status operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the payment status operation.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusResponse_204.description: Schema representing the response for a payment status check operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: User or system that created the payment status record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the payment status record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the payment status record was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit information related to the payment operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
